rules.rationale: Base equation defining the forward kept-character accumulator on an empty input sequence.
Conditional recurrence defining keptAcc when the current character occurs in the deletion string; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
Conditional recurrence defining keptAcc when the current character is retained and appended to the accumulator; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
Base equation defining the reversed kept-character accumulator on an empty input sequence.
Conditional recurrence defining reversedKeptAcc when the current character is deleted; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
Conditional recurrence defining reversedKeptAcc by prepending a retained character; its simplification attribute is used definitionally.
Base equation defining the final loop-target value when no input characters remain.
Recursive equation defining the final loop-target value as the last character traversed.
